result.summary: Analysis reveals minor visual polish issues related to content representation and layout constraints.

issues.description: Generic vector illustrations are used as placeholders instead of actual restaurant food photography.
issues.suggestion: Implement high-resolution food photographs to improve visual appeal and trustworthiness.

issues.description: Text truncation occurs for longer restaurant titles in the horizontal scrolling sections.
issues.suggestion: Adjust card width or implement multi-line text support to ensure full names are visible.
